description: This file contains unit tests for the 'lists' utility module within the 'summernote' project, testing list operations such as first/last element retrieval, filtering, clustering, and array transformations.

methods.name: lists.head
methods.description: Returns the first element of the list.

methods.name: lists.last
methods.description: Returns the last element of the list.

methods.name: lists.initial
methods.description: Returns all elements except the last.

methods.name: lists.tail
methods.description: Returns all elements except the first.

methods.name: lists.find
methods.description: Finds the first element matching a predicate.

methods.name: lists.all
methods.description: Checks if all elements satisfy a predicate.

methods.name: lists.contains
methods.description: Checks if an array contains a certain element.

methods.name: lists.sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of elements, with optional transformation.

methods.name: lists.from
methods.description: Converts a NodeList to an array of DOM nodes.

methods.name: lists.clusterBy
methods.description: Clusters array elements by a comparison function.

methods.name: lists.compact
methods.description: Removes falsy elements from an array.

methods.name: lists.unique
methods.description: Removes duplicate elements from an array.
